reasoning: Output A is the more complete, evidence-bounded four-week analysis. It explicitly separates facts, inferences, and uncertainty/confidence for each of eight requested dimensions; names the synthetic-only source, date range, cache freshness limitation, partial-record boundary, and Garmin exclusion; preserves the workable structure; and limits itself to two condition-based changes with concrete follow-up measures. Output B is readable and cautious, but it compresses the review into a small set of mixed evidence bullets rather than providing the requested eight-dimension fact/inference/uncertainty analysis. Its confidence and verification treatment is also less systematic, so it is less useful for a disciplined next-cycle review.
